title: Vietnamese Coconut Pandan Waffles (Banh Kep La Dua) - Vicky Pham
ldName: Vietnamese Coconut Pandan Waffles (Banh Kep La Dua)
ldKeywords: vietnamese pandan waffles, pandan waffles recipe, banh kep la dua, pandan waffle recipe, vietnamese waffles, pandan coconut waffles, green waffles, pandan dessert, crispy pandan waffles, easy pandan waffles recipe, pandan waffles with pancake premix, quick pandan and coconut waffles, banh kep easy recipe, bank kep with pancake premix
ldIngredientsRaw: 2 tablespoons vegetable oil plus additional 1 tablespoon for greasing waffle iron
ldInstructionsRaw: In a large bowl, mix together premix pancake flour, egg, coconut milk, vegetable oil, sugar and pandan extract until smooth. Mix in shredded coconuts (optional) until combined.
Ladle about 1/3 to 1/2 cup batter onto the preheated waffle iron. Close lid and cook until little to no steam rise from the waffle iron (about 2-3 minutes).
